Alex Chen: Quick weekly check for Mosaic onboarding — summary below, flagging potential renewal risk if performance doesn't stabilize.
Priya Kapoor: Thanks Alex. High level numbers?
Alex Chen: WoW tokens ingested +12%, QoQ +34%. 95p latency jumped 120ms -> 260ms since Tuesday. Error rate up to 3.8% (was 0.7%). Spend for the trial org spiked ~42% this week due to retries. Link to dashboard: https://redwood.internal/cs/mosaic/overview :eyes:
Jamal Rivers: Saw increased retries in the ingestion pipeline around Wed 02:45 UTC. Logs show a spike in 429s from the dedicated pool then a fallback to hosted variant.
Lina Gomez: +1. Customers hitting fallback are on older model pin config; fallback uses a higher-cost instance type.
Priya Kapoor: That explains spend. Any single bucket responsible for most traffic?
Alex Chen: Top 3 routes (embedding-create, chat-stream, rerank) account for 78% of tokens. embedding-create has the biggest latency variance.
CS-Bot: Automated alert — token rate > baseline by 28% and error rate > threshold for 6 hours. Incident ID: CS-1975-MOSAIC.
Jamal Rivers: Proposed immediate actions: 1) Short-term: increase dedicated pool headroom for Mosaic by 10% and enable adaptive routing to lower-cost variant for non-SLA routes. 2) Mid-term: patch the retry backoff in the SDK to avoid tight loops. 3) Enable prefix caching for embedding-create where applicable.
Priya Kapoor: I'll own coordination with Mosaic PMs for consent to throttle non-critical routes. @Jamal can you open a runtime ticket for the retry backoff patch?
Jamal Rivers: On it — filed RT-8242, tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre. ETA for patch review: 48 hours.
Lina Gomez: I'll prep a short enablement note for Mosaic engineers explaining how to pin to quantized model variants and how to use our per-route cost controls.
Alex Chen: Thanks. Can someone run a quick cost delta after enabling adaptive routing and share expected savings? If we can show ~20% spend reduction, that lowers renewal risk.
Priya Kapoor: Will do. Running a sim now, will post numbers in this thread in ~2 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex Chen: Perfect. TL;DR action items: Priya — cost sim & customer sync; Jamal — retry backoff ticket & patch; Lina — enablement note; I'll request temporary capacity bump. Follow up in thread. :thumbsup:
